name: Scroll Text Fill
use: A large statement starts muted and fills to full ink word by word as you scroll; italic or bold words fill to the accent. Reverses when you scroll back up.
notes:
Over the 8 KB budget (unminified) because of the exact-innerHTML restore, aria-label bookkeeping and per-marker overrides. Scroll-linked, not time-based: fill comes from the text's top edge between 85% and 40% of the viewport, so it reverses on scroll up and survives resize with no re-split (word spans stay inline). rAF runs only while a filled block intersects the viewport. Accent blend uses color-mix() with currentColor; browsers without color-mix show the accent at the dim opacity instead. aria-label + aria-hidden words on headings only; paragraphs keep their words exposed because aria-label is not allowed on

. Words inside a link: the underline under spaces stays full strength while words are dim.
